rows.text:
This is a mysterious seance newspaper.

It takes two people to operate.

Both of you, keep your eyes on this little wispae. It's highly sensitive to Wishpower.

The incantation to awaken the seance newspaper goes:
"Furbricato, Furbricato, please descend to us. Furbricato, Furbricato, please descend to us..."

Now just silently think of the question you wish to ask, and wait for the wispae to reveal the answer.
